items.name: dock_x
items.label: E
items.basis: x registration at set start. As designed there is no x datum (mobile.py: the bumper fixes y only): homing at the counter-end stop + encoder counts. Indexed stop / pin per station; touch-off.

items.name: odometry_x
items.label: E
items.basis: in-set cart travel up to ~1 m (the wok carry 0.66 m, spatula 1.05 m, hub edges up to 1.15 m): 0.5 % (effective tyre radius not calibrated, slip) / 0.1 % calibrated. Encoder: ZLTECH ZLLG65ASM500 4096 lines (S), resolution 0.03-0.13 mm, not the limit. R09 counts it inside its +-2 mm.

items.name: dock_y
items.label: E
items.basis: bumper on the cabinet fronts: door flushness +-1 mm + bumper compression +-0.5 mm; datum rail / stop on the plinth; touch-off.

items.name: dock_yaw
items.label: E
items.basis: bumper over 0.56 m on fronts that are flush to +-1.5 mm -> +-0.3 deg; V-block + flat; touch-off. Pivot: the arm J1 axis.

items.name: floor_z
items.label: E
items.basis: floor height under the 4 contacts + tyre radius (R09 requirement +-1 mm height).

items.name: floor_tilt_x
items.label: E
items.basis: tile floor unevenness ~0.5 mm across the 0.21 m caster-to-drive-wheel base (flatness spec of tiled floors is commonly 2 mm / 2 m; not verified in the standard text). Toward the counter = tilt_x -. Static per station: measured at commissioning (3-point touch-off / inclinometer) and compensated in dock_stops / touch_off.

items.name: floor_tilt_y
items.label: E
items.basis: as above across the 0.44 m track.

items.name: load_tilt_x
items.label: E
items.basis: tyre / caster / bumper / cabinet-front compliance under the arm moment (~60 N m with the wok at reach, #13): lean toward the counter. Posture-dependent, so a set-start touch-off does not remove it; stiffer bumper datum + measured pre-compensation. Mast bending: 0.003 deg (120x120x4 steel tube est.), negligible.

items.name: mount_xy
items.label: E
items.basis: arm base on the mast plate: four M8 bolts (S, UR manual) in clearance holes; dowel-pinned + calibrated plate.

items.name: mount_yaw
items.label: E
items.basis: base rotation in the bolt clearance; pinned.

items.name: arm_accuracy
items.label: S/E
items.basis: UR5e absolute accuracy with the sim's nominal kinematics: >= 2 mm (S, ROS answers 324883); with the robot's own factory calibration exported into the checker: ~0.3 mm (E).

items.name: arm_repeatability
items.label: S
items.basis: UR5e pose repeatability +-0.03 mm, ISO 9283 (S, datasheet).

items.name: tracking_sync
items.label: E
items.basis: servoj path following + cart / arm clock skew (4-10 ms x 0.25 m/s); #6. Hardware-synchronized cart axis / slower near tight spots.

items.name: thermal
items.label: E
items.basis: aluminium arm 0.85 m x 23e-6/K x 15 K = 0.3 mm; steel cart 0.2 mm; hot wok rim +0.4 mm radius.

items.name: grasp_offset
items.label: E
items.basis: held part in the jaws: keyed block, form-fit pads (R11) +-0.5 mm; +-1 mm with wear / debris.

items.name: grasp_turn
items.label: E
items.basis: turn about the jaw axis under the moment (wok 6.47 of 7 N m PGC limit).

budget.fixture_basis: cooker: freestanding induction cooker (moved for cleaning) vs a counter-fixed locator; lid rack / spider rest / spatula pad: screwed to the counter, positions from a tape survey vs robot touch-off; faucet body / sink / upper cabinets / hood / counter: kitchen survey (tape +-2-3 mm vs touch-off +-0.3-0.5 mm); lever clip: hand-fitted clip vs keyed clip; plates: by hand vs a guarded stand; raw food on the prep tray: not a fixture (+-15 mm whatever the registration); all E.
